description:
ServerName<'a> and MailboxName<'a> are parameterized by 'a — the borrow of the input string. Internally they hold Cow<'a, str>, so the lifetime is only meaningful when the result happens to be Cow::Borrowed; the Cow::Owned cases (lowercased ASCII, A-label-converted U-label, IDN) carry an effectively-'static buffer hidden behind the 'a parameter.

Caller impact (forcing-defensive-code):

1. Any caller that stores a ServerName in a struct must thread 'a — even though the type may already own its data. This propagates the lifetime through Verifier configs, batch processors, cache structs.

2. Returning a ServerName from a function that took owned input requires *constructing* a 'static-lifetime version. The only way to do that today is to leak the input string or stash it somewhere with the right scope. There is no:

       ServerName::into_owned(self) -> ServerName<'static>

   or:

       ServerName::from_owned_dns_name(name: String) -> Result<Self, IdentityError>

3. Callers writing trait objects need 'static bounds everywhere; ServerName<'_> can't satisfy them.

4. The pkix-chain Verifier per AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 must admit batch + caching patterns. Caches need 'static keys or values; ServerName<'a> can't be a cache key without the caller pre-allocating string buffers themselves.

This is the same shape that rustls-pki-types::ServerName solved by being 'static-only (owns its data; takes &str by value at parse, allocates if needed). webpki::SubjectNameRef takes the opposite stance (always-borrow) but adds a SubjectName owned variant.

The current shape — generic over 'a, but secretly may own — is the *worst* of both worlds: callers pay the lifetime tax even when nothing borrows.

Recommend (one of):

a) Make the type 'static-only: store Box<str> / String / Box<[u8]>, drop the 'a parameter entirely. The borrowed-input fast path can return a ServerName built from the input string, allocating in any non-trivial case. This matches rustls-pki-types::ServerName.

b) Keep 'a but add into_owned(self) -> ServerName<'static>, with the existing 'a constructors retained as the zero-alloc fast path.

c) Add 'static-only sibling types ServerNameOwned, MailboxNameOwned with conversions.

Severity P1 because the 'a parameter is part of the published API surface; removing it later is a breaking change. This decision must be made before 1.0.

Related to PKIX-68mt.14 (Cow<'a, str> decision already filed as P3) but distinct — that filing is about the *internal* representation; this filing is about the *external* lifetime parameter and the missing into_owned() escape hatch.
title: ServerName / MailboxName lifetime 'a forces caller-thread of borrow forever; no into_owned() / 'static escape hatch
